_comment: The upstream sources this directory is ported from, pinned by commit and by content hash.
Machine-readable on purpose: `npm run check:vendored-parser` reads it, fetches the same files
from the tracked branch, and fails when they no longer hash as pinned. That is the event worth
catching - upstream moving on while this port stays behind. PROVENANCE.md explains the port;
`track` is the branch the check compares against. It is `master` because that is the released
code; `develop` there is work in progress.
Updating: re-port the changed file, then update its hash and `commit` here in the SAME commit,
so the diff shows the port and the pin moving together.
